sourceMappingEvidence: Inspected actual runtime contact sheet and full original status-board-01; visually matched motif, never inferred alphabetical slot order.
functionalMotif: The full original maintenance cluster is preserved: one dominant cog, one rectangular component, one bolt, one diagonal open-jaw/ring wrench, and two differently sized hex nuts. Blue openings, an amber ring end, and small amber cog insets remain bounded on hardware.
reconstructionCaveats: Tiny threads, bevel divisions and scratches are simplified. The original gear center has a purple backdrop through its blue ring; the remake correctly uses real transparency through that opening. The exact tooth count is not a semantic acceptance criterion.
postprocessing: Exact original reference crop only. Generated raw and master bytes are identical. No recolor, keying, alpha cleanup or pixel repainting. Whole-canvas resize only for separate QA derivatives.
catalogScope: C02 catalog-only source asset. No authored campaign consumer or live status integration is claimed.
